reason: A is the stronger proposal because it extends a demonstrated 5 at.% Sn pest-suppression result into the target equiatomic alloy with explicit exposure and mechanical-property controls. Its transferability remains uncertain because the protective Sn-rich phases were observed in Si-containing Nb-silicide alloys, but B’s assumption that only 5 at.% Al will form continuous external alumina despite strongly oxygen-reactive Hf, Zr, and Ti is less physically supported and largely restates a generic alloy-design concept.
